body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

However, I find the default description box too tall:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/76a9aff0-c465-4666-8189-b54e5b326fd2)

I think it should default to the lowest size you can drag to, which means it would look something like this out of the box:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ac1850d1-b1c4-4b0e-8e51-dc2b0123c907)
